group.label: Agent
group.comment: This installation reports as a single site to the dashboard, so these settings apply to the whole Magento instance, not per store view.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Master switch. Off, no cron job or plugin in this module sends anything - the "Test Ping" button below still works while off, so a site can be fully configured and verified before switching this on.

field.label: Dashboard Endpoint URL
field.comment: Full ingest URL issued by the StackGauge dashboard, e.g. https://dashboard.example.com/api/ingest.

field.label: Site Identifier
field.comment: Issued by the dashboard when this site is registered. Sent in every report so the dashboard knows which site it came from.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: Bearer token issued by the dashboard for this site. Stored encrypted.

field.label: HMAC Secret
field.comment: Shared secret used to sign every report (X-StackGauge-Signature header) so the dashboard can verify it wasn't tampered with in transit. Stored encrypted.

field.label: Enabled Reporters
field.comment: Built-in data collected in each full report. Third-party reporters added by other modules aren't listed here and stay on regardless - see the README's "Pluggable reporters" section.

field.label: Monitored Log Files
field.comment: Files (relative to var/log) the Logs reporter shows a recent-lines tail for on the dashboard, each under whatever name you give it here. Pre-filled with the built-in System Log/Exception Log - remove either if you don't want it, or add more (e.g. a custom integration's own log). A file path (containing "/" or "..") is silently ignored.

field.label: Log Level
field.comment: Minimum severity written to var/log/stacknuts_stackgauge.log. "Off" disables logging entirely. Set to "Info" to have every report logged in full even before a dashboard endpoint exists to send it to - useful on its own, not just for debugging.
